source_image_hashes: sha256 per image in feature table; Stage 1 artifacts/raw_hashes.json
extraction_status: one row per image; status and failure_reason are explicit

feature_definitions_and_units.brightness: mean luminance 0.299 R + 0.587 G + 0.114 B; RGB in [0,1]
feature_definitions_and_units.contrast: standard deviation of the same luminance
feature_definitions_and_units.saturation_mean: mean Pillow HSV saturation divided by 255
feature_definitions_and_units.saturation_std: standard deviation of Pillow HSV saturation divided by 255
feature_definitions_and_units.colorfulness: Hasler-Susstrunk rg/yb colorfulness on RGB in [0,1]
feature_definitions_and_units.sharpness_laplacian_var: variance of four-neighbor luminance Laplacian on interior pixels
feature_definitions_and_units.entropy_bits: base-2 entropy of 32 luminance bins over [0,1]
feature_definitions_and_units.edge_density: fraction of interior central-difference luminance magnitudes above 0.12
feature_definitions_and_units.warm_pixel_ratio: fraction of pixels with normalized R minus B above 0.04
feature_definitions_and_units.hue_mean: saturation-weighted circular Pillow HSV hue mean divided by 2 pi
feature_definitions_and_units.aspect_ratio: original oriented image width divided by height
feature_definitions_and_units.log_pixels: natural logarithm of oriented image width times height
feature_definitions_and_units.overexposed_frac: fraction with Pillow HSV value divided by 255 above 0.98
feature_definitions_and_units.underexposed_frac: fraction with Pillow HSV value divided by 255 below 0.02
feature_definitions_and_units.is_effectively_gray: 1 if mean absolute R-G plus G-B is below 0.01; otherwise 0
feature_definitions_and_units.log_file_kb: natural log of 1 plus max(file bytes,1) divided by 1024

resize_crop_interpolation: 256x256 maximum thumbnail; bicubic; aspect preserved; no crop
size_features: original EXIF-oriented dimensions; bytes from source file
